_README.purpose: Targeting + AoE for Edha talents (Foundry MeasuredTemplates), driven by register-skills.js. (1) Attunement Range PREVIEW: a per-talent button draws a range ring scaled to the talent's leyline color rank. (2) POINT-TARGETED BURSTS: talents with a `burst` block are intercepted at preUseItem - the cost is consumed, a [Size] template is dropped at the caster, the player DRAGS it to any point in Attunement Range, then clicks Detonate to capture & resolve everyone inside (true point targeting; replaces the old center-on-target + manual-Apply AoE).

fields.color: OPTIONAL leyline color override for range/size scaling (white/blue/black/red/green). Usually auto-derived; set it only when the formula doesn't name a color.
fields.area: { shape:'circle', sizeByRank:true } gives radius [2.5,5,10,15,20] ft by the color's rank; OR { shape:'circle', sizeFt:N } for a fixed radius.
fields.burst: Presence of this block routes the talent through the point-targeted burst engine. { rangeByRank:true | rangeFt:N (placement range), save:{ skill:'ath', vs:'<color>' } (auto-roll each enemy's save for half), addSkillMod:'<color>' (add the test-skill mod to full damage, matching the system's skill_test full-hit), heal:true (heal allies, capped at max HP, no save), terrain:true (also drop a scene-long dangerous-terrain Region at the point - GM-side) }.

_README.scales: Attunement Range by rank = [15,30,60,90,120] ft; [Size] by rank = [2.5,5,10,15,20] ft.
_README.damage: Damage/heal formula + type are read from the talent itself (system.damage), so the [Tier][Die] stays rank-correct. Owned riders (e.g. Kindle) still apply. Save success = half of the full amount. Note: bursts roll their own damage, so they do NOT fire deal-damage triggers like Arc Flash.
_README.pilot: Point-targeted bursts: Flame Surge (enemy save-for-half), Set Charge (10 ft detonation + terrain), Mending Aura (ally heal), Thorn Field (terrain). Pyre stays a single-target attack (its terrain drops via the native place-hazard event on the struck target).
